common_prompt_specification: Identity-preserving hand-painted production game atlas. 1536x1024 landscape transparent RGBA, six fully contained full-body sprites in three phase columns and two direction rows. Fixed high-angle game camera. Exact source face/costume/equipment, native anatomical crown-to-foot height >=340px requested. Single connected weapon, real torso/arm perspective, head above feet; no whole-image rotation, mirroring fallback, extra weapon, effects, flash, arrows, labels, text, floor, shadow or opaque background. Three distinct windup/release/recovery poses with consistent scale and stable anatomical feet; physical weapon aim follows requested screen direction. Direction y is positive down.

metadata_method: Manually observed absolute source-pixel anatomical crown, foot, forward grip, and gun aperture/staff crystal tip. Region bounds from separate alpha>64 connected silhouettes plus one pixel margin, verified six separated fullbody silhouettes per atlas. Body height = foot.y-head.y, excludes backpack/raised weapon. Weapon axis = normalized observed muzzle-grip, not copied from direction labels.
validation: All 24 unique direction/phase regions per hero; all anchors and regions in source bounds; min bodyheight>=320; all observed weapon-axis target dots >=0.95. Genuine alpha zero background, body alpha nearopaque up to254. Brown RGB under zeroalpha intentionally preserved.
runtime_status: Enabled. Final three-hero native 2560x1440 graphical acceptance: 433 checks, zero failures, 96 direction/phase samples; 502 sampler and anchor contract checks. Controlled test evidence is local only.
